claim: Skill triggering and post-trigger outcome quality are separate evaluation problems
evidence_summary: Agent Skills separates description triggering from with-skill outcome comparison; OpenAI documents progressive disclosure
preconditions_or_limits: Exact discovery behavior can vary by Codex version and the set of installed skills

claim: Marginal skill benefit requires a named baseline under comparable tasks
evidence_summary: Primary sources use skill/no-skill or baseline/candidate comparisons and recommend establishing the baseline before a behavior change
preconditions_or_limits: A baseline does not control model or infrastructure drift unless those variables are also pinned

claim: Verified outcome and execution trajectory provide complementary evidence
evidence_summary: Outcome inspection checks the end state while trace or transcript grading checks behavior during execution
preconditions_or_limits: Trajectory capture may be incomplete and can expose sensitive content

claim: An agent evaluation result describes the tested configuration rather than one isolated component
evidence_summary: Across the reviewed systems result meaning depends on combinations of task model or agent harness environment and grader
preconditions_or_limits: Component attribution still requires controlled paired experiments

claim: Objective properties should use deterministic graders when they can be inspected directly
evidence_summary: Tests schemas and state inspection provide direct evidence; model or human graders cover semantic qualities
preconditions_or_limits: A deterministic grader can still encode the wrong target or be vulnerable to gaming

claim: Repeated trials and environment provenance are needed to interpret stochastic agent results
evidence_summary: Sources recommend repetitions uncertainty measures and controlled runtime variables
preconditions_or_limits: Required repetition count depends on variance task cost and decision risk

claim: Outcome quality token use and elapsed time are all relevant and should remain separately visible
evidence_summary: Sources record outcome measures alongside usage and timing rather than establishing a universal combined score
preconditions_or_limits: Token counts differ across tokenizers; time is affected by provider and infrastructure load

claim: Infrastructure settings can materially change coding-agent benchmark results
evidence_summary: Anthropic reports score movement under resource changes and the frameworks expose resource and network controls
preconditions_or_limits: The reported effect size is experiment-specific and should not be generalized

claim: Portable committed cases and artifacts are safer long-term evidence than dependence on one hosted dashboard
evidence_summary: OpenAI recommends committed eval cases and is retiring its hosted Evals workflow; open tools preserve configs and artifacts
preconditions_or_limits: Portability does not remove maintenance cost or make every artifact safe to publish

claim: Harbor supplies execution and evidence machinery but does not define OpenBoa quality
evidence_summary: Harbor delegates success to task verifiers and dataset metrics
preconditions_or_limits: A high-quality OpenBoa task and verifier could still run on Harbor

claim: Inspect AI exposes rich per-sample usage timing trajectory and statistical evidence
evidence_summary: Official docs expose usage time messages events scores dataframes and uncertainty metrics
preconditions_or_limits: External agents may not expose every side effect and configured cost needs pricing data

claim: The inspected Hydra behavior suite measures explicit skill invocation rather than implicit description triggering
evidence_summary: The runner prepends an explicit skill invocation to each live trial; checked-in case inputs do not test description-based triggering
preconditions_or_limits: Observation is pinned to the named v0.2 candidate commit

claim: Hydra has no measured v0.2 quality token or time baseline in the inspected evidence
evidence_summary: The complete r13 ledger is for v0.1; the v0.2 r14 attempt reports 21 unmeasured cases
preconditions_or_limits: A later run may change this state and must be recorded as new evidence

claim: Hydra defines an outcome canary but has no accepted canary run ledger in the inspected snapshot
evidence_summary: Scenario and schema exist but no accepted result ledger was present
preconditions_or_limits: Observation is pinned to the named commit and does not predict later GitHub state

claim: Public reproducibility and private holdout integrity create a real trade-off
evidence_summary: Public tasks and traces aid auditability but can expose graders data and benchmark content
preconditions_or_limits: The right public-private split depends on OpenBoa's threat model and transparency goals

claim: The reviewed primary sources do not establish one universal weighted score for quality tokens and time
evidence_summary: The sources expose multiple measures and customizable aggregation but no cross-domain universal weighting
preconditions_or_limits: This is bounded to the registered corpus and may change with further research
